subject: Agent reply contract when the final reply has no JSON
question: (a) keep rejecting a reply without the JSON contract, or (b) accept-and-record it when all required outputs pass the gates
statement: additional prose doesnt seems to be good, since can create fuzzy answer and consume tokens, better is to produce just what is expected
decision: (a) The strict reply contract stays: the final reply is only the requested JSON. Prose is reduced at the source (CAPA-045: Codex model_verbosity low, trailing reply rule), never accepted by relaxing the gate.
also_decided: OK to merge feat/004 into feat/005 and feat/005 into feat/006 with merge commits (no force-push, nothing to main)
